subject: general
question: Gair dance is performed by the ________ community of Rajasthan.
solution:
The correct answer is __Bhil__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Gawari, Hathimana, and Gair dance are performed by the Bhil tribes of Rajasthan.
 
• Kalbelia, Bhawai, Shankariya, Paniyari, Indoni are the Professional folk dances of Rajasthan.
 
• Agni, Terahtaali, Gavri, Languria, Ghoomar, Ghudla are social & religious folk dances of Rajasthan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4004ff32af305d78a71400db3c73c9905d6bb86e734679d7daa58faf015b4d74.png]
